Wash a plate three times and cook fried:
def Wash_a_plate_three_times_and_cook_fried_egg():
	# 0: Wash the plate three times
	walk('Plate')
	pickup('Plate')
	walk('Faucet')
	toggleon('Faucet')
	put('Plate', 'SinkBasin')
	toggleoff('Faucet')
	pickup('Plate')
	toggleon('Faucet')
	put('Plate', 'SinkBasin')
	toggleoff('Faucet')
	pickup('Plate')
	toggleon('Faucet')
	put('Plate', 'SinkBasin')
	toggleoff('Faucet')
	pickup('Plate')
	walk('CounterTop')
	put('Plate', 'CounterTop')
	# 1: Cook fried egg
	assert('Pan' on 'StoveBurner')
		else: walk('Pan')
		else: pickup('Pan')
		else: walk('StoveBurner')
		else: put('Pan', 'StoveBurner')
	walk('StoveKnob')
	toggleon('StoveKnob')
	walk('Egg')
	pickup('Egg')
	walk('Pan')
	assert('Egg' in 'hand')
		else: walk('Egg')
		else: pickup('Egg')
		else: walk('Pan')
	assert('close' to 'pan')
		else: walk('pan')
	put('Egg', 'Pan')
	slice('Egg')
	walk('StoveKnob')
	toggleoff('StoveKnob')
	# 2: Done
